name: johansen_juselius
title: Johansen and Juselius (1990): Danish money demand
summary: The published case for a restricted constant, restrictions and weak exogeneity, on public data: Danish log real money, log real income, the bond and the deposit rate, quarterly 1974-1987, 55 observations, four univariate models built by sima's raw entry (deterministic seasonality where it was found). With n = 55 the asymptotic table is least trustworthy: the rank by parametric bootstrap (drvec, B = 499, shipped in the example's cache) does NOT reject r = 0, where Johansen and Juselius, with the asymptotic trace test, found one relation. The C nodes follow on their theory, written as such.
plan: N1 run_gate — four models built by sima's raw entry (not reviewed in art)
N1b canonical_analysis — two components near 1 of four
N1c prepare_vec — purpose "long run", p = 2, case 2 (the restricted constant)
C1 rank_test (B = 499, cached) — no comparison rejected at 5 % (r = 0: LR 25.91 against 29.78, p 0.12); the asymptotic table would reject at 10 %
C2 estimate_vec r = 1 ON THEORY, normalised on LRM — the money-demand relation
C3 test_restriction — weak exogeneity of income and the rates, by LR
C5 long_run — the income and interest elasticities, the half-lives
